name: Buff-vented Bulbul
rangeDescription: Thai-malay peninsula, sumatra, bangk, belitung, anambas, and natuna islands
description: Dull brown bulbul with a long slender bill and pale gray eyes. Gray-eyed Bulbul is very similar but has darker, buffier underparts and is more warmly-colored overall; ironically, Gray-eyed Bulbul’s buffy rump is brighter.

name: Worthen's Sparrow
rangeDescription: Northeastern mexico (coahuila to nuevo león, zacatecas, and veracruz)
description: Very local, scarce, and endangered small sparrow of desert plateau in northeast Mexico. Mainly found in rolling, short-cropped grassland (especially prairie-dog towns), with scattered yuccas and junipers.

name: Rufous-bellied Antwren
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela to the guianas and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Tiny resident of tall rainforest. Wary and can be difficult to see well; note distinctive sputtering alarm call, tiny size, plain face, and large white (male) or buffy (female) wing spots.

name: Taiwan Yuhina
rangeDescription: Montane forest of taiwan
description: A small, tit-like endemic songbird, brown above, white below, with a very distinctive head pattern: the pointed crest is white with a black-bordered chestnut front, and the ear coverts are outlined in black on the white face. Inhabits hilly and montane forests, where it roams about in large chattering flocks at all levels of the forest.

name: Black-eared Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Australia
description: Small plain cuckoo with a dark eye and black

name: Cinereous Harrier
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia to tierra del fuego and falkland islands
description: Fairly common in open country of Patagonia, often near lakes and marshes; uncommon and local northward. Male silvery gray overall with fine rusty barring below.

name: Cape Bulbul
rangeDescription: South africa (southern and southwestern cape province)
description: A typical open-country African bulbul that is uniform ashy-brown in coloration with a yellow undertail and a conspicuous and diagnostic whitish eye-ring. Pairs and small groups forage in coastal scrub, fynbos, and gardens, eating a variety of fruit and invertebrates.

name: Uniform Finch
rangeDescription: Eastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina
description: Slender finch found at forest borders where it is especially associated with bamboo. Usually forages on or near the ground.

name: Munchique Wood-Wren
rangeDescription: Western andes of colombia
description: A small, stub-tailed wren endemic to Colombia’s western Andes. It has a long, white eyebrow and a streaky face.

name: Bronzy Jacamar
rangeDescription: Central amazonia, from eastern colombia and southern venezuela eastward to the guianas, southward to southeastern peru (madre de dios), northern bolivia, and south-central amazonian brazil (south to mato grosso)
description: Small, active, and locally distributed. Key field mark is overall bronzy color, which is evident in good light but hard to see otherwise.

name: Henderson Island Reed Warbler
rangeDescription: Henderson island (pitcairn archipelago)
description: A large warbler with a variably white head and body. Crown and uppersides often mottled olive-brown and white, underside often tinted yellow.

name: Buff-crested Bustard
rangeDescription: Southeastern south sudan to eastern ethiopia, djibouti, and somalia to northeastern uganda, kenya, and north-central tanzania
description: A fairly small bustard of thick brush in dry country. The male has a buff crest that is usually hidden, and both sexes have a black belly.

name: Ryukyu Robin
rangeDescription: Breeds danjo islands (off southwestern kyushu) and northern ryukyu islands (tanegashima southward to tokunoshima); winters southward to the southern ryukyu islands (mainly miyako, ishigaki, iriomote, and yonakuni, southern japan)
description: Rather tame songbird of shady subtropical broadleaf forests. Breeds in the northern Ryukyu Islands, with some migrating to the southern Ryukyu Islands.

name: Pallid Harrier
rangeDescription: Central eurasia; winters to southern africa, india, and myanmar
description: Males are ghostly gray above with black wingtip wedges. Females are more difficult to separate from other harriers; pay attention to the underwings with their barred primaries and dark secondaries.

name: Indigo Macaw
rangeDescription: Caatinga of eastern brazil (northern bahia); on verge of extinction
description: Large, beautiful blue macaw. Note the bare yellow eyering and base of lower mandible.

name: Lesser White-fronted Goose
rangeDescription: Breeds arctic eurasia; winters to southern europe, india, and china
description: Generally uncommon medium-sized goose. Dark chocolate brown with a white forehead and bubblegum-pink bill.

name: Chestnut-bellied Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Guadalcanal, malaita, and makira (solomon islands)
description: A large dark pigeon with a deep chestnut belly and undertail. Entirely dark above with a contrasting paler head.

name: Dusky Nightjar
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Small dark nightjar with very limited range in the highlands of Costa Rica and Panama. Few obvious plumage features: entire body is intricately patterned with dark brown, black, and buff.

name: Hainan Partridge
rangeDescription: Montane forest of hainan (off southern china)
description: Small game bird restricted to the tropical rainforests of southern Hainan Island, where it is the only forest-dwelling partridge. Body is brown above and gray below; head is black with a bright white ear patch and an orange collar.

name: Narrow-tailed Starling
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to northern angola, democratic republic of the congo, and western uganda; bioko
description: A starling with a piercing gaze that is not easily forgotten, often found in flocks high in fruiting trees in forests, primarily in the lowlands but sometimes high in the mountains. Males are a glossy purple-black all over with a long, pointed tail, and females are a duller gray-black all over with a short tail.
